In {{aniseries|DP}}, [[Ash Ketchum]] arrives in the [[Sinnoh]] [[region]] with his {{AP|Pikachu}} and meets {{an|Dawn}}, a new {{pkmn|Trainer}} aspiring to become a [[Top Coordinator|Top]] [[Pokémon Coordinator]]. Along the way, Ash has his ideologies as a Trainer challenged by his newest [[rival]], [[Paul]], and the trio gets involved in a plot schemed by the villainous [[Team Galactic]], linking their journey with the fate of the entire Sinnoh region.
